title: Act: Call playSceneTransition from BootScene.create
description: In BootScene.create, create the effect context once, pass it to buildEffects and playSceneTransition.
acceptance_criteria: create() calls playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) after buildEffects

steps.action: Add import { playSceneTransition } from '@game/engine/playSceneTransition'; after the buildEffects import.
Replace the inline createPhaserEffectContext(this) argument with a const ctx, pass ctx to buildEffects, then call playSceneTransition(ctx, scene) on the next line.
steps.expected: The fade plays on scene start
